_comment: 'When you play this, if you have less {h} than an opposing hero, this gets +3{p}.' Shape copied verbatim from the sibling drafts adrenaline_rush_red/yellow in this same .drafts folder (which themselves follow reckless_arithmetic_blue): PLAY + HEALTH_LT_OPP gate + MODIFY_ATTACK add 3. Verified against handlers: MODIFY_ATTACK (effect_types.py) appends to CombatState.power_mods when resolved from a non-recalc event, so the pump survives later recalculations; HEALTH_LT_OPP (condition_types.py) takes no params and compares controller.life < players[3-pid].life. Ability-level conditions are evaluated at resolution, i.e. when the card is played - matching 'when you play this, if ...'. Blue prints the same +3{p} as red per the batch text. No other clauses.
